title: UNDERCROFT: RACKS COLUMN, CODEX FOUR COLUMNS, STASH TYPE
why: Critic b-31 on the Undercroft screens (racks 14 at 1, codex 65 at 2, stash 04 at 2): buttons 1316px wide in a 1700px card, hint lines 14px, the codex a top-left grid with a dead lower half, 12px plates on the stash. One centred 672px racks column at 16px, a centred four column codex, 14px stash plates, two filler lines gone (reasons in changes.md).
now: Racks page is one centred column, the codex is four columns, stash plates are bigger.
